programs.title: 60 Minutes
programs.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programs.title: CBS Weekend News
programs.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programs.title: Face the Nation
programs.desc: "Face the Nation," which is one of the longest-running news programs on the air, offers insight and analysis on the top issues of the day. Moderator Margaret Brennan welcomes politicians, government leaders and international newsmakers to a roundtable discussion of current events with CBS News correspondents.

programs.title: CBS News Roundup
programs.desc: The headlines one needs to know overnight... plus, a roundup of MoneyWatch, health, consumer and up-to-the-minute technology news, the latest weather, and inspiring stories of kindness and hope.

programs.title: CBS News Mornings
programs.desc: CBS News Mornings broadcasts on weekdays and offers viewers up-to-date news, comprehensive weather forecasts, and highlights from the world of sports.

programs.title: CBS Morning News
programs.desc: Join Errol Barnett for the CBS Morning News weekdays at 7AM ET. Featuring the latest breaking news, in depth original reporting and news making interviews plus all the big stories impacting Americans from coast to coast.

programs.title: CBS Mornings
programs.desc: Hosts Gayle King, Tony Dokoupil and Nate Burleson set out to unite CBS' morning landscape with their lively and original reporting on international news stories during the weekday program's first hour, while expanding on feature reporting during the second hour with live interviews as well as in-depth pieces, covering topics from news, sports, climate and technology to race, health, parenting and personal finance. The team broadcasts from a new state-of-the-art studio in New York's Times Square.

programs.title: CBS News 24/7 Mornings
programs.desc: CBS News 24/7 is your trusted source for live National and Local breaking news and in-depth reporting on the issues shaping your world.

programs.title: CBS News 24/7
programs.desc: Coverage, reporting and storytelling from CBS News and Stations; a look at how news coverage comes together.

programs.title: The Takeout with Major Garrett
programs.desc: The Takeout is a new spin on the widely acclaimed podcast hosted by CBS News Chief Washington Correspondent Major Garrett. A daily streaming show that harnesses the best of CBS News's political reporting and lives comfortably in deep discussions of economics, pop culture, sports and technology.
